{{Quote|I am doing important work, but I could use some help.|Dayana, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GIotDP" />}}
'''Dayana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] peacekeeper who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Down below, do you see that bunker? Some Drall terrorists are using it as they plan their future crimes. I mean to stop them, but I need to know what they are planning. Could you enter their bunker and find out? The information I seek can be downloaded from their data terminals.|Dayana, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GIotDP" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Dayana was present on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] were she investigated a group of [[Drall Patriots]],<ref name="SWG:GIotDP" /> an organization of [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] extremists fighting for the independence of [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] from the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] government.<ref name="SWG:DPC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Drall Patriot's Cave|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she tracked them to a [[Drall Patriot Warehouse|warehouse]] on the outskirts of the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. Dayana was afraid that the Drall Patriots were using the bunker to plan their future attack. The Selonian therefore recruited an independent spacer<ref name="SWG:GIotDP" /> who also had worked for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> She tasked the spacer to infiltrate the warehouse and download information from their data terminals to discover what they were planning. The spacer eventually returned to Dayana successful and the Selonian ensured that the information gathered would be crucial to stopping the Drall Patriots before they could harm innocent people.<ref name="SWG:GIotDP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dayana was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GIotDP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dayana was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
